segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I have the 42-seat subscription scoped for your operations and finance teams, plus the standard onboarding package. Wanted to confirm the start date and billing setup before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. The seat count is right for now. We may add 6 more in Q2, but I don't want those on the initial invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. Initial order will show 42 seats only. If you add the 6 later, they'll be prorated through the same March 31, 2027 term end. No separate renewal date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the price you sent was $38 per seat per month, annual upfront, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. That's $19,152 for the seats for the year, and $4,500 for onboarding, so first invoice would be $23,652 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can we do net 45 on the invoice? Our AP team is pretty firm on that for new vendors.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 45 is available on this package. I'll put that in the payment terms on the order form. Billing contact is still ap@northpointfabrication.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, and copy me. For go-live, we need April 15. Is that realistic if we sign by Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If signature is in by March 8, kickoff would be March 12, data import the week of March 18, admin training March 27, and user training April 9. That supports April 15 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Contract term is one year, no auto-renew unless we agree in writing?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right. One-year initial term, renewal by written order only. I'll send the order form with 42 seats, net 45, March 8 signature target, and the April 15 go-live plan noted.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it over and I'll route it to our controller today.
